zh: 「文君當爐」出自《史記・司馬相如列傳》，是中國文學中極富浪漫色彩的典故。卓文君出身蜀中富戶，新寡而才情出眾；司馬相如家境清寒，卻以琴才與辭賦聞名。兩人一見傾心，私奔成都，卻因生活困頓，只得在臨邛開設酒肆。卓文君不顧世俗眼光，親自站在爐邊賣酒，司馬相如則在店中招呼客人，成為「文君當爐，相如滌器」的佳話。此典故象徵為愛甘於清貧、才情與情感並重、對封建禮教的溫柔反叛，後世常用來讚美真摯愛情與女性勇於自主的人生選擇。後人認為卓文君私奔司馬相如是“史馬遷欲為古今女子開一奇局，使皆能自拔耳”。卓文君有不少佳作，如《白頭吟》，詩中“ 願得一心人，白頭不相離 ”堪稱經典佳句。
en: "Wenjun as an Oven" comes from "Historical Records and Simasian Biographies", which is an allusion to the extremely romantic color in Chinese literature. Zhuo Wenjun was born in Shu Zhongfu, a newly widowed and outstanding. Sima Xiang is as cold as his family, but he is famous for his talent and rhetoric. At the sight of them, they eloped to Chengdu, but because of their difficult life, they had to open a liquor store in Linyi. Zhuo Wenjun disregarded the worldly vision and personally stood by the fireside selling liquor. Sima Xiang greeted guests in the store and became a good saying that "Wenjun is like a purifier like a stove". This allusion symbolizes the love of poverty, the equal importance of talent and emotion, and the gentle rebellion against feudal ritualism. It is often used in later life to praise sincere love and women's courageous life choices. Posterity believed that Zhuo Wenjun's elopement with Sima Xiang was like "Sma's desire to create a strange situation for ancient and modern women, so that everyone can pull out their ears." Zhuo Wenjun has many good works, such as "White Head Groaning". In the poem, "I wish to be single-minded, and the white heads are not separated" is a classic sentence.

zh: 蘇子愀然，正襟危坐，而問客曰：「何為其然也？」客曰：「『月明星稀，烏鵲南飛』,此非曹孟德之詩乎？西望夏口，東望武昌。山川相繆，郁乎蒼蒼，此非孟德之困於周郎者乎？方其破荊州，下江陵，順流而東也，舳艫千里，旌旗蔽空，釃酒臨江，橫槊賦詩，固一世之雄也，而今安在哉? 況吾與子漁樵於江渚之上，侶魚蝦而友麋鹿，駕一葉之扁舟，舉匏樽以相屬。寄蜉蝣於天地，渺滄海之一粟。哀吾生之須臾，羨長江之無窮。挾飛仙以遨遊，抱明月而長終。知不可乎驟得，托遺響於悲風。」　--蘇軾 《前赤壁賦》
en: Su Ziran sat in danger and asked the guest, "Why is that?" The guest said, "'The moon star is rare, Wuxi Nanfei', this is not the poetry of Cao Mengde? Xiwang Xiakou, Dongwang Wuchang. Mitsuyoshi Yamakawa was overwhelmed by the sky. This is not Meng De's trap in Zhou Lang? Fang Jia Zhou, Xia Jiangling, along the river and Dong Ye, a thousand miles away, a banner was emptied, a wine was near the river, a poem was conferred horizontally, and the hero of Gu Yi also, and now he is at peace? Situated above the Yangtze River, I and my son, the fish and shrimp, and the elk, drive a leafy flat boat and lift a barrel to belong to each other. Sent to heaven and earth, a drop in the sea. I mourn my birth and envy the endlessness of the Yangtze River. Lei Feixian traveled and embraced the bright moon for a long time. Whether you know it or not, leaving behind the tragic wind." - Su Zheng's "Former Scarlet Wall Fist"

zh: ChatGPT AI 對這首俳句的解謮:
en: ChatGPT AI's interpretation of this haiku:

zh: 這首短詩篇幅極短，卻層次豐富，兼具典故、異地感、人生況味與瀟灑的自我辯證。可從四個層面來讀。
en: This short poem is very short, but it is rich in layers, with allusions, a sense of distance, a taste of life, and a dashing self-justification. It can be read on four levels.

zh: 一、首句：時空的疊影
「法國小酒莊，遙念文君當爐」
en: I. First sentence: The superposition of time and space
"French small winery, Yaonian Wenjun as a stove"

zh: 這一句極妙。
法國小酒莊，是異域、現代、旅途中的現實場景；
文君當爐，則是中國古典文化中最著名的愛情與勇氣典故之一。
兩者並置，形成一種時空錯位的疊影：
異國的葡萄酒香，喚起千年前臨邛酒肆裡的炊煙與人影。
en: That's a brilliant phrase.
French small wineries are exotic, modern, and realistic scenes on the road.
Wenjun is one of the most famous allusions to love and courage in Chinese classical culture.
The two are juxtaposed to form a stack of spatiotemporal dislocations:
The exotic wine scent evokes the cooking smoke and people in the Rinju Wine House a thousand years ago.

zh: 這不是單純的懷古，而是 ----
當下的飲酒之人，與歷史中敢於「潦倒而美」的靈魂，短暫對望。
en: It's not just nostalgia, it 's--
The drinkers of the moment, and the souls who dare to be "down and beautiful" in history, are facing each other for a short time.

zh: 二、第二句：對「潦倒」的重新命名
「一個美麗的潦倒，是過客」
en: II. Second sentence: renaming "abject"
"A beautiful downfall, a passer-by"

zh: 這一句是全詩的精神核心。
「潦倒」本是失意、貧落、漂泊的詞，
卻被你加上「美麗的」三字，
於是它不再是失敗，而成為一種姿態。
en: This sentence is the spiritual core of the whole poem.
"Humiliation" is originally a word for frustration, poverty, and wandering.
But you added the word "beautiful" to it.
So it is no longer a failure, but a gesture.

zh: 「是過客」更關鍵——
這潦倒不是命運的定義，而是旅途中的一站。
如文君與相如當年短暫的困頓，如此刻旅人在酒莊的一杯酒。
潦倒因為短暫，而顯得美。邂逅因為短暫，而顯得珍貴。
en: "Is a passer-by" is more important--
This is not a definition of destiny, but a stop in the journey.
Like Wenjun and the short-lived troubles of that year, such a moment is a glass of wine for guests at the winery.
Impoverishment is beautiful because it is short-lived. Encounters are precious because they are short-lived.

zh: 三、第三句：反問中的超脫
「何必釃酒臨江？」
en: III. Third sentence: transcendence in rhetorical questions
“Why is there a need for sake in the river?”

zh: 「釃酒臨江」直指蘇軾《赤壁賦》的豪放傳統——
那是一種對宇宙、人生、無常的盛大感慨。
en: "Liquor in the River" refers directly to the opulent tradition of Su Xi's Chibifu--
It was a great feeling for the universe, for life, for impermanence.

zh: 但你在此反問：
既然只是過客，既然不打算把短暫的感傷升格為永恆的嘆息，
那又何必刻意借酒對天地發言？對歷史慨嘆？
這是一種對生活姿態本身的自覺與節制。
en: But here's your rhetoric:
Since it is just a passer-by, since it is not intended to elevate the temporary sentiment into an eternal sigh,
Then why do you deliberately use alcohol to speak to the world? Marveling at history?
It is an awareness and moderation of the way of life itself.

zh: 四、結句：灑脫的收束
「明日又天涯」
en: IV. Conclusion: The End of the Spill
"Tomorrow and Beyond"

zh: 全詩在此輕輕落下。不是悲，不是嘆，
而是早已知曉——
明天仍要上路，仍要分別，仍要遠行，仍要探索。
en: The whole poem falls gently here. Not sadness, not sighing,
It's what we already know--
Tomorrow is still on the road, still separate, still far away, still to explore.

zh: 這一句讓整首詩從「懷古」轉為「行旅哲學」：
不執著於一杯酒、一段情、一則典故，
而是把它們放在路途中，讓它們自然沈浮。
en: This phrase changed the entire poem from “nostalgia” to “travel philosophy”:
Not clinging to a glass of wine, a love affair, an allusion,
Instead, put them on the road and let them float naturally.

zh: 五、總結一句話
en: 5. Summarize a sentence

zh: 這首詩寫的是，在異鄉路過酒莊時，與古人短暫對酌。
承認人生的潦倒，卻拒絕把它演成悲劇。
因為明日，又是天涯，又是另一番景象。
走向一種現代旅人式的清醒，溫柔與瀟灑。
en: The poem is about a brief encounter with the ancients as they pass a winery in a foreign land.
Acknowledging life's downfall, but refusing to turn it into a tragedy.
Because tomorrow is the end of the world and another scene.
Towards a modern guest-like sobriety, gentleness and sleekness.

We look at the reflection of the sea, how it fluctuates to obscure the rocky shore.

zh: 《老人與海》（The Old Man and the Sea）是美國作家海明威（1899—1961）1952年創作的中篇小說。該小說是海明威生前發表的最後一部主要小說作品。小說講述老漁夫聖地牙哥的故事，以及他為了抓一條大馬林魚那漫長又艱苦的過程。獲奬: 普立茲小說獎（1953），諾貝爾文學獎（1954）。著名小說家張愛玲是《老人與海》中譯本的第一人，於1952年12月發表。
en: The Old Man and the Sea is a 1952 novella by American author Ernest Hemingway (1899—1961). It was Hemingway's last major novel. The novel tells the story of the old fisherman San Diego and his long and arduous process of catching a big marlin. Awarded: Pulitzer Prize for Fiction (1953), Nobel Prize for Literature (1954). The famous novelist Zhang Ailing was the first person to translate "The Old Man and the Sea", which was published in December 1952.

可以洞察到宏觀的宇宙真理。 它強調了「心境」的重要性，當心清淨時，就能在平凡
的事物中見到無窮的世界與襌性。 這句偈語也常被引申為一種哲學觀念，提醒人們要
學會從細微之處看見宏大的世界，並尊重每一個生命與事物。
en: "One flower, one world, one leaf is the same" is a Buddhist phrase from the Hua Yan Sutra, meaning from the microscopic details
Macro-cosmic truths can be discerned. It emphasizes the importance of the “state of mind” that when you are cleansed, you will be able to
Infinite worlds and natures are seen in things. This catchphrase is also often echoed as a philosophical reminder to
Learn to see the big world in small ways and respect every life and thing.

zh: Think Again: The Power of Knowing What You Don’t Know
en: Think Again: The Power of Knowing What You Don't Know

points.zh:
《博客來書摘提要》 :
每個人都習慣以最舒適的方式思考，不願懷疑或挑戰自我，因為「質疑」會讓世界變得難以預期，甚至威脅到自我認同，於是，我們的成見不斷延續，聰明成為盲點，害怕改變的「順思維」讓我們選擇劃地自限。
若想要突破自我限制，就必須建立「科學家」的「逆思維」，打破成規，大膽反思。不同於信仰堅定的「牧師」，或是巧舌如簧的「政客」，「科學家」不會讓自己的想法成為意識形態，也不會妄下定論，而是會讓問題帶領我們前進，關鍵不在於誰對誰錯，而是明白自己的欠缺與不足。
從自己到他人，從他人到群體，從群體到社會。「逆思維」幫助我們用開放的心態，提升心智的彈性，建立良性的衝突，在瞬息萬變的世界中找到平衡點。真正的「知道」，就是承認自己的「不知道」。只要謹慎思考，凡事再想一下，就能掙脫成見枷鎖，突破認知盲點，掌握永不被淘汰的核心競爭力！
這個時代最重要、也最具影響力的課題之一就是：質疑自己根深柢固的信念。他說「真正的知道，就是承認自己的不知道」，傾聽和了解我們的一無所知，正是我們此刻所需要的能力！
points.en:
Blog Letters Abstract:
Everyone is used to thinking in the most comfortable way, unwilling to doubt or challenge themselves, because "questioning" can make the world unpredictable and even threaten self-identity. Therefore, our prejudices continue to persist, smartness becomes a blind spot, and we are afraid of the "right thinking" of change. Let us choose to limit ourselves.
If you want to break through self-restraint, you must establish the "reverse thinking" of "scientists", break the rules, and boldly reflect.Unlike a "pastor" who is firm in his faith or a "politician" who is as clever as a tongue, a "scientist" will not let his ideas become ideologies or jump to conclusions, but will let problems lead us forward. The key is not who is right or wrong, but to understand their own shortcomings and shortcomings.
From self to others, from others to groups, from groups to societies.“Counter-thinking” helps us use an open mind, increase mental resilience, create benign conflict, and find balance in a rapidly changing world.To truly “know” is to admit that you “don't know.”As long as you think carefully and think about everything again, you can break free from the shackles of stereotypes, break through the blind spots of cognition, and master the core competitiveness that will never be eliminated!
One of the most important and influential issues of our time is to question our deep-rooted beliefs.He said, “To really know is to admit that we don't know.” Listening to and understanding what we don't know is exactly what we need right now!

points.zh: 「星空，非常希臘」是詩人余光中最具代表性，傳誦不絕的詩句。從這首詩裡，可以感受到海天一色，湛藍的地中海氣息．衆星垂顧的絢麗星空，以及希臘千古不朽的文明。「星空，非常希臘」，「希臘」明明是地理名詞，余中光卻在這𥚃把名詞當作形容詞用，他用「希臘」來形容夜晚大度山的星空，把他當下的感受，跳躍時空，轉入遠古希臘的星空，神話飛揚，燦亮永恆，流淌著古典，華麗又抒情，扼要又活潑地表現出來。
points.en: "Starry sky, very Greek" is the most representative and endlessly recited poem of the poet Yu Guang. From this poem, you can feel the color of the sea and sky, the blue Mediterranean atmosphere, the gorgeous starry sky overlooked by the stars, and the immortal civilization of Greece. "Starry sky, very Greek", "Greece" is clearly a geographical term, but Yu Zhongguang uses the noun as an adjective here. He uses "Greece" to describe the starry sky of Mount Dadu at night, his current feelings, jumping into the time and space, turning into the starry sky of ancient Greece. Myths are flying, bright and eternal, flowing classically, gorgeous and lyrical, brief and lively expressed.

zh: 米羅:《戴著漂亮帽子的女人，星星 (Woman with a beautiful hat, star) 》1978。
這張油畫作品純粹又純真，而且深受當時收藏家喜愛。圖中右下方有一個黑圓點，其目的在讓作品中的結構達到平衡，與左邊的放射狀星星達到對等重量。畫面上藍底的中心有一個水滴的造型，代表著是女人身體，強烈的紅色把所有的焦點集中在她身上，她帶著一頂帽子，帽子帶有「角」的形狀；背景的藍天有著層次的筆觸讓畫面看起來更有「味道」。星星以「米」字代表，是黑暗中指引出希望座標的象徵。
en: Miró: Woman with a beautiful hat, star (1978).

The painting was pure and innocent and loved by collectors at the time. There is a black dot at the bottom right of the diagram, which aims to balance the structure in the work and achieve the same weight as the radial star on the left. The center of the blue bottom on the screen has a shape of water droplets, representing the woman's body. The intense red color focuses all on her. She is wearing a hat with the shape of "horns"; the blue sky in the background has layers of brush strokes to make the picture look more "flavorful". The stars are represented by the word "m", which is a symbol that guides the coordinates of hope in the dark.

points.zh: 米羅 (Joan Miro, 1893-1993) 是西班牙三大畫家之一，和畢加索，達利齊名。以超現實，簡約圖相，表現如夢似幻的詩意。他的畫藴藏著異想天開，反覆無常和幽默的趣味。加上扭曲的人物動物，變形的有機體和異乎尋常的幾何構造，使作品顯得特別。明亮濃麗的色彩，尤其是藍，紅，黃，綠，黑和留白，銳利的線條，點和花樣，架構成隨時變形的阿米巴圖様 (Amorphous Amoebic) 。米羅的三大靈感來源「女人」、「小鳥」及「星星」，其中強調他畫的女人並非為生物，而是一整個宇宙；飛翔的小鳥則連結了陸地與天際；而閃耀的星星既可代表高不可攀的天外世界，也可視為宇宙廣大心靈對抗黑暗的標誌。米羅除經歷多變的繪畫風格，也致力於嘗試以不同的素材從事藝術創作，他所創造出的符碼在不同的材質上呈現，彷彿能穿越天際、星辰，到達浩瀚宇宙，再將所掌握的宇宙星辰捕捉回地球的一張紙上。米羅的藝術表現是高度個人化的經驗感受，以自成體系的符碼，向世人展現他心中的天地。米羅的畫表現出純真卻又隱含著諷喻和幽默，給人強烈的衝突感，也藉此展現出他對世界、生命的熱情。  (整理自Sotheby’s)
points.en: Joan Miro (1893-1993) was one of the three great Spanish painters, along with Picasso and Dalí. Surreal, minimalistic, and fantastically poetic. His paintings are whimsical, capricious and humorous. Coupled with distorted people and animals, deformed organisms and unusual geometry make the work special. Bright and intense colors, especially blue, red, yellow, green, black and white, sharp lines, dots and patterns, frame the Amorphous Amoebic that deforms at any time. Miro's three major sources of inspiration are "woman", "bird" and "star", which emphasize that the woman he painted is not a living creature, but a whole universe; the flying bird connects the land and the sky; and the shining stars can represent the unattainable outer world and can also be regarded as a symbol of the vast mind of the universe against the darkness. In addition to experiencing a variety of painting styles, Miró is also committed to trying to create art with different materials. The codes he creates are presented on different materials, as if he can cross the sky and stars to reach the vast universe, and then capture the cosmic stars back on a piece of paper on Earth. Miró's artistic expression is a highly personalized experience that reveals his world to the world in a self-contained system of codes. Miró's paintings are pure but implicitly ironic and humorous, giving a strong sense of conflict, which also shows his enthusiasm for the world and life. (Organized by Sotheby's)

en: NASA Releases 20 New Images for the First Time, Nov 6, 2025. Take a journey across space and time through some of NASA's newest images captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, Hubble, and Chandra. Webb's infrared eyes, Hubble's timeless vision, and Chandra's X-ray gaze together uncover the places where stars are born, where they die, and where galaxies continue to evolve. Iconic columnar structures are the so-called “Pillars of Creation,” the cradle of countless newborn planets.

points.zh:
黃自（1904-1938）中國作曲家，音樂教育家，原籍江蘇省川沙縣（上海浦東）。黃自出身好家庭，飽讀詩書，尤愛音樂。 1916年進入北京清華學校，接觸西洋音樂。 1924年清華學校畢業，赴美國俄亥俄州歐柏林學院留學，攻讀心理學，畢業後於1928年轉入耶魯大學學習西洋音樂的理論與作曲，1929年畢業後回國。返國後任教於上海滬江大學、國立音樂專科學校等學校。 1935年，黃自發起創辦了上海管弦樂團，這是全華人組成的第一個管弦樂團。 1938年，因傷寒症在上海逝世。作品包括《踏雪尋梅》、《中華民國國旗歌》、《旗正飄飄》、《抗敵歌》、《玫瑰三願》、《 西風的話 》等。

points.en:
Huang Zi (1904-1938) Chinese composer and music educator, originally from Chuansha County, Jiangsu Province (Pudong, Shanghai). Huang Zi came from a good family, full of poetry and love of music. In 1916, he entered Beijing Tsinghua School and was exposed to Western music. After graduating from Tsinghua School in 1924, he went to Oberlin College in Ohio to study psychology. After graduation, he transferred to Yale University in 1928 to study the theory and composition of Western music. After graduation, he returned to China in 1929. After returning to China, he taught at Shanghai Shanghai Jiang University, National Conservatory of Music and other schools. In 1935, Huang founded the Shanghai Orchestra, the first Chinese orchestra. He died of typhoid fever in Shanghai in 1938. His works include "Ta Xue Xuan Mei", "National Flag Song of the Republic of China", "Flag Floating", "Anti-Enemy Song", "Three Vows of Roses", "Words of the West Wind", etc. Chorus "Words of the West Wind"...
